ios.desc:
Rubbish Talk cuts through media spin. We take the news — markets, economy, tech, world events — and strip out the sugarcoating so you get the facts, not the framing.

• R-Score — every story rated 1–10 for how much spin it's carrying
• Rubbish Checks — plain-English breakdowns of what the headline left out
• Check any article — paste a link and get your own spin-check (Premium)
• Save the stories you want to come back to
• Ad-free and offline reading with Premium

No agenda. No hype. Just what actually happened.
